This instance keeps the YoY comparison fully decidable anyway by embedding BOTH fiscal years' values as separate named fields (fy_prior/fy_current) and setting atom E5's numeric_ge THRESHOLD to the prior year's own real value (established exactly by atom E4): E5 then evaluates 'current_value >= prior_value' via the ordinary numeric_ge predicate, mechanically, over the actual field the tool reads at run time -- the model never has to compute or guess the comparison itself, and the runtime never trusts a self-report.

The identifying/existence facts are established (C1) and the record's RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax figure for FY2025 is confirmed to equal exactly $94,827,000,000.
